name: Incomplete Leaver Deprovisioning Across Entra ID and Keycloak
description:
A terminated healthcare employee may retain access to the Mock EHR application because disabling their Microsoft Entra ID account does not automatically disable the corresponding federated Keycloak account.

During Jeevan Smith's termination (TERM-2026-0301), Entra ID access was disabled, but the Keycloak account required additional manual deactivation. This creates a potential risk of unauthorized access through stale accounts or existing sessions.

The risk will be evaluated using the project's existing R02 risk assessment, JML evidence, and HIPAA-aligned workforce termination controls.
existing_applied_controls: Terminated users are disabled and all access removed promptly,Control gaps are tracked to verified remediation,Security risks are identified, scored and treated,Workforce Termination and Access Revocation
additional_controls: Access is reviewed periodically and findings are remediated,Automated Keycloak Leaver Deprovisioning
